+class SGP2LiteFuse(nn.Module):
+    """Lightweight semantic-detail fusion for the VisDrone P2 detection branch."""
+
+    def __init__(self, c1, c2, hidden=32, layer_scale=1e-2):
+        super().__init__()
+        if c1 != 2 * c2:
+            raise ValueError(f"SGP2LiteFuse requires c1 == 2*c2, got c1={c1}, c2={c2}.")
+        if hidden <= 0 or hidden > c2:
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid hidden channels: {hidden} for c2={c2}.")
+        self.c1, self.c2, self.hidden = int(c1), int(c2), int(hidden)
+        self.semantic_proj = Conv(c2, hidden, 1, 1)
+        self.semantic_local = DWConv(hidden, hidden, 3, 1)
+        self.detail_proj = Conv(c2, hidden, 1, 1)
+        self.detail_local = DWConv(hidden, hidden, 3, 1)
+        self.fuse = Conv(2 * hidden, c2, 1, 1, act=False)
+        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(torch.full((1, c2, 1, 1), float(layer_scale)))
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        """Fuse upsampled P3 semantics followed by backbone P2 details."""
+        if x.ndim != 4 or x.shape[1] != self.c1:
+            raise ValueError(f"Expected BCHW input with {self.c1} channels, got {tuple(x.shape)}.")
+        semantic, detail = x.split((self.c2, self.c2), dim=1)
+        residual = 0.5 * (semantic + detail)
+        semantic = self.semantic_local(self.semantic_proj(semantic))
+        detail = self.detail_local(self.detail_proj(detail))
+        correction = self.fuse(torch.cat((semantic, detail), dim=1))
+        return residual + self.gamma * correction
+
